description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InputInspectionValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressMachineButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InputAdditionalValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InspectionSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InspectionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Start entering machine details"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionSplit" name="Begin inspection activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" name="Ask inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputInspectionValues" name="Input requested values"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressMachineButtons" name="Press machine buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Automatically collect values from the machine"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowMachineValues" name="Show collected values"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionJoin" name="Inspection activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions needed based on the results?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" name="Ask additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputAdditionalValues" name="Input requested additional values"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection questions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Type" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_To_Serial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Serial_To_Split" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Questions" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Questions_To_InputValues" sourceRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputInspectionValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputValues_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_InputInspectionValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Buttons" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_PressMachineButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buttons_To_Collect" sourceRef="Task_PressMachineButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_To_Show" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Show_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_ShowMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions" name="Additional questions needed based on results" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalQuestionsNeededBasedOnResults</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskAdditional_To_Input" sourceRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputAdditional_To_End" sourceRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
